newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Thousands march over Belgian child sex scandals.
newsitem.headline: Thousands march over Belgian child sex scandals.

text.p: A march by an estimated 275,000 Belgians and sympathisers from neighbouring countries -- one of the largest in the country's history -- began at 2:30 p.m. (1230 GMT) on Sunday in Brussels.

The beginning of the demonstration -- an outpouring of anger and frustration aimed at the political and judicial classes in the wake of a kidnap, murder and child sex scandal -- was held up for half an hour due to congestion at the starting point.
"So far everything is very calm," a police spokesman said, noting many of the marchers were parents and children.
Thousands were still arriving at the capital's North Station on packed trains.
Belgian railways said trains from all over the country were being stopped just outside Brussels to avoid overcrowding at stations.
